summary: Tested the new Calorie deficit feature end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_deficit.py (15 tests) covering GET /api/deficit/monthly structure, math, edge cases and regressions; ran full suite (test_deficit.py + backend_test.py + test_preset_names.py) = 44/44 passed. Verified Aug 2026: weight_kg=97, tracked_days=15, total_intake=28649, total_burn=38027, net_deficit=9378, est_weight_change=1.22 kg; Aug 5 => steps 12310, walking_burn 597, burn 2597, intake 1850, deficit 747 (exact spec match). Untracked days return intake=0/deficit=0 and never advance cumulative_deficit; last day's cumulative == net_deficit; Feb day counts correct for leap/non-leap; month 0/13 => 400; missing params => 422; Dec 2026 => tracked_days=0, net_deficit=0, 31 days. Regression: /api/summary/monthly (intake values cross-match deficit endpoint), /api/presets CRUD + PATCH rename + /log (logged meal correctly appears in deficit endpoint), /api/export/meals.csv, /api/nutrition/estimate all pass. Frontend: sidebar 'Calorie deficit' link (data-testid=deficit-navigation) is rendered directly below Meal history, navigates to /deficit and gets nav-active. /deficit renders hero, net-deficit '9,378 kcal', est-weight-change '-1.22 kg', all six stats (avg 1,910 / 2,535 / -625; totals 28,649 / 38,027), deficit-chart with 62 recharts bars + 2000 ReferenceLine, cumulative-chart with area path + daily-deficit line. Month nav prev/next updates deficit-selected-month and refetches; Dec 2026 shows deficit-empty-note and net-deficit 0. Weight warning hidden with weight=97 and correctly rendered when weight_kg is null (verified via response interception, stored weight untouched). API 500 renders data-testid=deficit-error. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow, layout stacks cleanly. No console errors.

issues: The orange 'Daily deficit' Line has no legend/key (the recharts Legend component is imported in Deficit.jsx but never rendered), so users cannot tell what the second series is. Consider adding a legend-inline block like the Intake vs burn card.
deficit-weight-warning briefly flashes on first paint because the condition is !data?.weight_kg and data is null while loading. Gate it with `!loading && data && !data.weight_kg`.

action_items: Optional polish: add legend for 'Daily deficit' line in cumulative-chart and remove the unused Legend import in Deficit.jsx.
Optional polish: suppress deficit-weight-warning flash during initial load.
critical_code_review_comments: deficit_monthly duplicates the month-range/start-end/steps_by_date setup already present in monthly_summary and export_meals_csv — extract a shared helper to keep the math in one place.
Baseline 2000 and 7700 kcal/kg are hardcoded in the endpoint; consider sourcing from db.settings so users with a different TDEE get accurate numbers.
For untracked days the endpoint still returns burn=2000+walking_burn while deficit=0; correct per spec, but the frontend nulls it out for charting, so consider documenting this contract.
seed_data_creation: Temporary preset TEST_deficit_preset + one logged meal on 2027-03-01 during the preset regression test; both deleted in teardown. No existing data or settings modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deficit backend + UI fully verified in iteration 6. Reusable suite at /app/backend/tests/test_deficit.py. Note: run preset-log regressions against a month other than the one used for the empty-month assertion (2026-12) since pytest.ini runs xdist workers in parallel and a logged meal will otherwise make the empty-month test flaky. Settings weight is 97 kg; Aug 2026 has 15 tracked days.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defects found. Two initial test failures were my own test-data issues: preset /log requires a capitalised segment ('Breakfast'), and logging into 2026-12 raced with the empty-month assertion under xdist parallelism. Both fixed in the test file.
